nodes.label: Prepaid Activation Journey Begins
nodes.desc: Use case MOB_PRE_ACT_RETL_001 (MPRA): the Retail Channel prepaid activation journey is initiated.

nodes.label: Journey & Session Management
nodes.desc: The Journey and Session Management capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: ID Capture & Verification (IDWise / MOI)
nodes.desc: The Customer Identification and Verification capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Customer & Account Creation
nodes.desc: The Customer and Account Management capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Default credit limit and Bill Cycle
nodes.desc: The system shall not populate Credit Limit and Bill cycle attributes for Prepaid journey

nodes.label: HRN nationality flag derivation
nodes.desc: System will Derive the HRN Flag as per the capability defined in Mobile Postpaid Journey

nodes.label: HRN advance payment message
nodes.desc: System will not display any HRN advance payment message for Prepaid Order

nodes.label: Customer & Account Details (Address, Contact, Email)
nodes.desc: The Customer and Account Management capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Eligibility, Blacklist & Credit Screening
nodes.desc: The Eligibility and Credit Control capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Prepaid product eligibility gate
nodes.desc: The system shall permit product selection only after successful completion of identity, customer status and line count eligibility validations.

nodes.label: Credit limit out of scope
nodes.desc: The system shall not create, amend or display a credit limit within the Prepaid Activation journey.

nodes.label: Bill cycle out of scope
nodes.desc: The system shall not create or assign a bill cycle within the Prepaid Activation journey.

nodes.label: Payment profile out of scope
nodes.desc: The system shall not create an auto debit payment profile within the Prepaid Activation journey.

nodes.label: Present Eligible Prepaid Plans
nodes.desc: The Product Catalogue and Cart capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Prepaid Plan/Add On Selection
nodes.desc: The system shall filter and Provide Preapid plan based on the custome eligibility and segment.

nodes.label: Cart Build: Add-Ons, Pricing & Discounts
nodes.desc: The Product Catalogue and Cart capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Special discount
nodes.desc: System should allow agent to select Prepaid Specific Discount based on the Plan Selection

nodes.label: Number Selection & Reservation
nodes.desc: The Number Management capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: SIM / eSIM Selection & Validation
nodes.desc: The SIM Management capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check-Out
nodes.desc: The Cart Validation & Check Out capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Starter pack and recharge charge collection
nodes.desc: The system shall include starter pack and initial recharge charges in the payment request where applicable.

nodes.label: Payment summary display
nodes.desc: The system shall display the payment summary and the total payable amount to the Retail Agent before payment is confirmed.

nodes.label: Contract Generation (CAF)
nodes.desc: The Contract and Documentation capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Key Information
nodes.desc: System should generate the Terms and condition related to Prepaid and rest of the CAF Capability to be reused from Mobile Postpaid activation

nodes.label: CAF generation from template
nodes.desc: System should generate CAF Template specific to Prepaid

nodes.label: Payment Collection (WinCash)
nodes.desc: The Payment and Inventory capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: SIM Card Charge Collection
nodes.desc: System should collect the SIM Card charges based on the Business rules defined in BR-013

nodes.label: Physical SIM inventory depletion
nodes.desc: The system shall deplete a Physical SIM or a Printed eSIM from stock through WinCash on payment completion.

nodes.label: Virtual eSIM inventory depletion
nodes.desc: Since Virtual eSIM is not allocated to store & the inventory is not mainatained at WinCash, eSIM depletion will happen at order fulfilment stage.

nodes.label: Order submission
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Retail Agent to submit the order once payment has completed successfully. (Status_Model: Order Draft/Pending Payment -> Open/Submitted, triggered by Agent submission.)

nodes.label: Order Submission & Routing
nodes.desc: The Order Submission capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Prepaid service creation
nodes.desc: The downstream fulfilment process shall create the prepaid mobile service and associate MSISDN, SIM and customer/service identifiers.

nodes.label: Charging System account creation
nodes.desc: The downstream fulfilment process shall create or update prepaid balance and applicable plan in Charging System for the activated MSISDN.

nodes.label: Prepaid plan and benefit activation
nodes.desc: The downstream fulfilment process shall activate prepaid plan and applicable prepaid benefits selected in cart.

nodes.label: Activation outcome synchronization
nodes.desc: The downstream fulfilment process shall synchronize activation outcome to CRM order status. (Status_Model: Order Open/Submitted or In Fulfilment -> Closed/Complete or Closed/Failed, triggered by the downstream completion or failure event.)

nodes.label: Welcome/activation lifecycle trigger
nodes.desc: The system shall trigger prepaid activation confirmation and lifecycle initiation according to configured prepaid rules.

nodes.label: Notification & Feedback (Medilia)
nodes.desc: The Notification and Feedback capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.

nodes.label: Prepaid Activation Journey Ends
nodes.desc: End of Order Capture Journey (source sheet section #15) following activation confirmation and lifecycle trigger.

agents.Name: Journey and Session Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Journey initiation, agent authorisation, Qnomy queue and ticketing, automatic tracking record creation, milestone persistence and draft order resume

agents.Name: Customer Identification and Verification
agents.Purpose / Feature: Identity document scan through IDWise, permitted document types, manual capture fallback, MOI validation and field comparison, identity status check and high risk nationality derivation

agents.Name: Customer and Account Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Existing customer and contact matching, new customer creation, account attribute derivation, contact model, address capture and email verification for prepaid activation

agents.Name: Eligibility and Credit Control
agents.Purpose / Feature: Connection type eligibility, age validation, blacklist screening, active line count control and prepaid service eligibility

agents.Name: Product Catalogue and Cart
agents.Purpose / Feature: Prepaid starter pack, add on and discount eligibility, cart creation and amendment, price recalculation and special discount evidence

agents.Name: Number Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Reserved number retrieval and auto population, category display sequence, Star Number entitlement and lock in, premium number charging, reservation lock and release

agents.Name: SIM Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: SIM type selection, physical and printed eSIM scan, Virtual eSIM generation, identifier validation, inventory reservation and eSIM delivery

agents.Name: Cart Validation & Check Out
agents.Purpose / Feature: Pre payment validation gate, eligibility, compatibility & cardinality rule check, payment request summary display

agents.Name: Contract and Documentation
agents.Purpose / Feature: Key information display and refresh, CAF template selection and generation, digital and offline signature capture, and supporting document upload

agents.Name: Payment and Inventory
agents.Purpose / Feature: Payment summary, upfront charge collection, WinCash request and response handling, receipt issuance and inventory depletion

agents.Name: Order Submission
agents.Purpose / Feature: Order submission and routing to fulfilment, activity capture, Customer 360 order views, completion and failure handling and tracking record lifecycle

agents.Name: Notification and Feedback
agents.Purpose / Feature: Order submission, failure and completion notification, regulatory notification to all MSISDNs on the QID, template configurability and feedback survey despatch

agents.Name: Network Activation/Deactivation and Fulfilment
agents.Purpose / Feature: Network activation/deactivation for fibre and fixed wireless access indoor, subscriber identity module activation/deactivation and order management status to the workforce; Network Activation of Prepaid Line

mpra_001_net_04.title: Prepaid plan and benefit activation
mpra_001_net_04.does: The downstream fulfilment process shall activate prepaid plan and applicable prepaid benefits selected in cart.
mpra_001_net_04.makes: Selected plan and benefits are active or pending activation according to fulfilment response.
mpra_001_net_04.example: MPRA_001_NET_04: Selected plan and benefits are active or pending activation according to fulfilment response.

mpra_001_net_05.title: Activation outcome synchronization
mpra_001_net_05.does: The downstream fulfilment process shall synchronize activation outcome to CRM order status. (Status_Model: Order Open/Submitted or In Fulfilment -> Closed/Complete or Closed/Failed, triggered by the downstream completion or failure event.)
mpra_001_net_05.makes: CRM receives completion or failure status from fulfilment.
mpra_001_net_05.example: MPRA_001_NET_05: CRM receives completion or failure status from fulfilment.

mpra_001_net_06.title: Welcome/activation lifecycle trigger
mpra_001_net_06.does: The system shall trigger prepaid activation confirmation and lifecycle initiation according to configured prepaid rules.
mpra_001_net_06.makes: Configured welcome/activation notification is triggered after successful activation.
mpra_001_net_06.example: MPRA_001_NET_06: Configured welcome/activation notification is triggered after successful activation.

mpra_001_not_01.title: Notification & Feedback (Medilia)
mpra_001_not_01.does: The Notification and Feedback capability shall be reused as-is from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) for Mobile Prepaid Activation, with no functional change.
mpra_001_not_01.makes: The Notification and Feedback capability behaves identically to its Mobile Postpaid Activation ("MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001") implementation when exercised within the Mobile Prepaid Activation journey.
mpra_001_not_01.example: MPRA_001_NOT_01: The Notification and Feedback capability behaves identically to its Mobile Postpaid Activation ("MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001") implementation when exercised within the Mobile Prepaid Activation journey.
